name: Bubblegum Coquette
subcategory: Slur for an attractive, sexualized, naive, and unintelligent woman
summary: Bubblegum Coquette is a variation of Coquette that incorporates elements of the Bimbocore and Babygirl aesthetics.
description:
Bubblegum Coquette is a variation of Coquette that incorporates elements of the Bimbocore and Babygirl aesthetics. It is a coquette substyle that is more suggestive than most, while still focusing on youth, girly 2000s nostalgia, toy and candy motifs, and bright pink.

The Bubblegum Coquette aesthetic juxtaposes cute, childish innocence with the burgeoning libido of young adulthood. This is portrayed visually through the pairing of cute, youthful imagery (candy, toys, sparkles, braces) with more explicit imagery (lingerie, adult content stars, high heels, etc).
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Sexuality, eroticism, youth, innocence, DDLG, femininity

visualDNA.colour: Bubblegum pink and blue, white, and pastel colors

fashion.Overview: The look can be described as a mixture between typical Coquette, Babygirl, and Bimbocore. The fashion adheres pretty strictly to the visuals and color palette. Alongside the candy motifs, you will also see stripes, plaid, polka dots, and fruit patterns -- typically strawberries or cherries. It is common to also see cartoons/mascots represented on the clothing, frills, lace and bows, and butterflies and unicorns. Skirts are worn both high- and low-waisted, but jeans are typically low-waisted.

fashion.Bottoms: Frilled/ruffled mini-skirts; Denim mini-skirts; Tennis skirts/pleated skirts; Bloomer shorts; Denim mini shorts; Denim jeans, often low-rise; Pajama pants
fashion.Full-Body: Mini dresses; Babydoll dresses; Bodycon mini dresses; Jumpers and shortalls; Lingerie dresses (negligees and babydolls); Childlike nightgowns; One piece swimsuits
fashion.Shoes: High heels and "pleasers"; Converse; Mary Janes; Chunky platform shoes/heels; Flip flops and sandals
fashion.Hair, Makeup and Beauty: Hair in pigtails, ponytails, loose curls and braids; Glittery eye makeup and lipgloss; Pink lips and blush
fashion.Accessories (both fashion and imagery): Letter beaded bracelets; Roller skates; Frilly socks; Knee-high and thigh-high socks; Glitter, sparkles, and sequins; Stuffed animals and children's toys; Backpacks; Braces; Hair bows, hair clips, barrettes and ballies; Candy and dress-up jewelry; Candy in general, particularly pinwheel/swirly lollipops; Adult film screenshots; Childlike feminine bedrooms; Girly 2000s computer graphics
